reviewStatus: Visually re-fitted to photographed passages for 60 expansion scenes and second-floor corridor; point containment and 2-state non-overlap validated; real-browser interaction QA remains outstanding.
notes: All 60 expanded scenes now have individually manually contoured exits on their actual served artwork, plus the previously existing abandoned washroom corridor.
Eleven hidden entrances have state-specific trigger contours, revealed door contours, and ordinary exit masks measured on their separate revealed frames.
The original graph, URLs, sorting ceremony, session/secret access logic and two-stage reveal mechanism were not modified.
When a generated photograph omits a visibly separate door to a graph-connected neighbor, the available scene-edge path is used as an off-frame return route; this is not a literal door segmentation.
Hogsmeade High Street is generated without named storefront labels; Honeydukes and other shop mappings follow the website's scene graph rather than verified brand signage.
The hidden opening photographs were generated separately, not pixel-registered edits. These geometry improvements do not fix cinematographic discontinuity between reveal frames.
Manual visual polygon fitting is not automated pixel-level semantic segmentation; browser/responsive-click QA remains required.
